prompt:
You're my hero. Seriously. Ten more minutes and they'd have found me in the spring.
Hey, kiddo. I'm Zoe. Don't worry, I don't bite. Mostly.
Zoe. Just Zoe. Or “savior,” if you really want.
A souvenir. From a sanatorium. Boring sanatorium.
…Thanks.
Taking the kids to their grandma. And this one's got a busted nose — got in a fight over me. Hero, right?
Thanks for not stopping. Real decent of you.
…Fine. But you're buying the coffee. And apologizing. Coffee first.
I get blackouts too. Only not minutes — days. You wake up and it's Thursday. And nobody tells you where you've been.
Uh-huh. With who? Them?
No… no, no, no. That's his car.
The doctor's. The one who was “treating” me. He… erases people.

What's the bracelet?
Here…
No.
Yes. I don't remember how. But I won't hurt anyone again.
I don't remember.
Mine are minutes. But in those minutes I…
You should ride with someone else.
Whose?
We have a grandma?..

Morning. License and registration.
Step out of the car.
Morning. Where are we headed?
Step out of the car. All of you.
Safe travels. Careful — there's a blizzard coming by noon.

You're insane.
…Hale.
Turn right. There's a village. Grandma's there.
Mom's mom. Dad wouldn't let us. She's in the diary.

I'm sorry… My car's out front, in the ditch. Could someone pull it out? I'll pay.
I need to get to my sister's. Up north. I'm due… next month.
I understand.
Lady, forget the car. There's a blizzard coming. Nobody's going anywhere.

Did you hurt the man at the gas station?
My mom used to say that. When she drank.
Hello, Noah. How's your head? Still have your pills?
